title: Eighteenmile original microcystin campaign reporting-limit support

method.selection: All original Microcystins/nodularin results in the 2023 source bank, grouped by station, SCDHEC-MICRO project and Sample-Other activity type. Dates are April 5 through October 17, 2023.
method.denominator: All retained result rows per source series; distinct original activities equal row counts in these five series.
method.quantified_mean: Sum of original quantified values divided by quantified result count.
method.mean_interval: Assume nonnegative concentration. Each quantified result contributes its reported value. Each result Below Reporting Limit contributes [0, its original reporting limit). Sum row intervals and divide by all-row count. Upper endpoints are excluded. Values are not imputed and these are not confidence intervals.
method.published_comparison: Printed Table 8 summaries use a separate 73-sample analytical cohort and report-specific censor substitution. The original campaign has 85 retained results. Both cohorts retain their original counts.
method.execution: Source arithmetic evaluated directly from the complete original CSV in V8; native consumer is measurement_workspace.observation_support using exported original Published studies context.

published_summary.censor_substitution: Below 0.016 ug/L replaced by 0.008 ug/L in published mean
